easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls more lands than you.
description:
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, targeting Beza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Skycoach Conductor, causing it to enter prepared.
Resolve All Aboard, blinking Beza.
When Beza enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure token, two 1/1 Fish creature tokens if an opponent controls more creatures than you, causing you to gain 4 life if an opponent has more life than you, and causing you to draw a card if an opponent has more cards in hand than you.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
